for (feature in features) {
  
  # Subset and transform the data for the current feature
  feature_df <- longFormat(scp[feature, ]) |>
      as.data.frame() |>
      filter(assay %in% c("lognorm_Precursors_quantiles","Peptides", "Proteins")) |>
      mutate(
      assay = factor(assay, levels = c("lognorm_Precursors_quantiles", "Peptides", "Proteins")),
      replicate = str_extract(primary, replicate_pattern),
      replicate = if_else(is.na(replicate), "1892", replicate),
      sample = str_extract(colname, "(?<=_)[0-9]+(?=FG\\.MS1Quantity)"),
      id = paste(replicate, sample, sep = "_"),
      condition = case_when(
        replicate %in% wt1_replicates ~ "WT 1: +/+; Mx1-Cre",
        replicate %in% wt2_replicates ~ "WT 2: fl/+",
        replicate %in% hetko_replicates ~ "HetKO: fl/+; Mx1-Cre"),
      feature_name = feature_names[feature]) 
  
  feature_df_mean <- feature_df %>%
  group_by(assay, replicate, sample, condition) %>%
  summarize(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

  # Define new colors for mean lines and points for each assay
  mean_line_colors <- c("lognorm_Precursors_quantiles" = "gray",  # Tomato
                      "Peptides" = "gray",                      # MediumSeaGreen
                      "Proteins_scaled" = "#005b96")  
  
# Plotting the original data points and the summarized mean lines on top
  p <- ggplot() +
       geom_point(data = feature_df, aes(x = sample, 
                                    y = value, 
                                    color = assay, 
                                    group = replicate)) +
  
  # Add the mean lines with specific colors for each assay
       geom_line(data = feature_df_mean, aes(x = sample, 
                                        y = mean_value, 
                                        group = replicate), 
            color = mean_line_colors[feature_df_mean$assay], # Assign mean line colors
            linetype = "solid", 
            size = 1) +  
  
  # Add mean points with the same colors as the mean lines
       geom_point(data = feature_df_mean, aes(x = sample, 
                                         y = mean_value, 
                                         group = replicate), 
             color = mean_line_colors[feature_df_mean$assay], # Assign mean line colors to points
             size = 1) +
    
        facet_grid(assay ~ condition, scales = "free_y", drop = TRUE) +  # Allow free y-axis scaling for different assays
        scale_color_manual(values = assay_colors) +  # Use original colors for data points
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8)) +
        labs(title = paste("Feature:", feature_names[feature]))

# Print the plot
print(p)

}
